title: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，面向日常编程与智能体工作流
summary: 谷歌 DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，主打日常编码和智能体工作流的速度与效率，已在谷歌搜索、Gemini 应用、API 及 Antigravity 等面向广泛用户开放。
title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，面向日常编程与智能体工作流
lead_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位快速执行的日常编码和智能体工作流，已在搜索、Gemini 应用和 API 等面向广泛用户开放。

body_zh.heading: 发生了什么
paras: 谷歌 DeepMind 发布新模型 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，由高级副总裁兼谷歌首席人工智能架构师 Koray Kavukcuoglu 撰文介绍。该模型面向日常编码和智能体工作流，强调速度与效率；同系列的 Carbon 和 Argon 则侧重处理更困难的长程推理任务。
在一项独立智力评测指数上，Hydrogen 默认高思考档得分为 **51**，超过 Argon 的 **50**，最高档可达 **54**。定价在整个 **100 万** 词元上下文窗口内统一：输入每百万词元 **1.50 美元**，输出每百万词元 **7.50 美元**。它提供低、中、高（默认）和全新最高档共四档思考深度。
谷歌宣布，该模型即日起在全球开发者、企业和消费产品中逐步上线。开发者可在 AI Studio、Android Studio 和编程接口中使用；付费的 Pro 与 Ultra 订阅用户可在 Antigravity 中试用；所有用户可在 Gemini 应用和谷歌搜索中使用。

body_zh.heading: 谷歌怎么说
paras: 据谷歌称，相较上一款快速模型 3.8 Flash，Hydrogen 在默认高档完成任务速度快 **2.5 倍**，一项终端编程基准得分由 **18.2%** 升至 **57%**，捏造内容减少 **5 倍**以上。谷歌还推出可在同一会话里动态切换模型的编排器；在相关基准上，其任务成功率接近 Carbon，同时平均少消耗 **24%** 配额、完成速度快 **19%**。

fulltext.author: Koray Kavukcuoglu
fulltext.author_title_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 高级副总裁兼谷歌首席人工智能架构师
fulltext.dek_en: Hydrogen brings cutting-edge intelligence to everyone.
fulltext.dek_zh: Hydrogen 把前沿智能带给每一个人。
fulltext.omitted_note: 原文另有 1 条脚注，未收录
fulltext.disclaimer_zh: 本文由 AI 按原文正文逐段翻译，表格、代码等内容可能未收录；如有出入以原文为准。图片与视频版权归原作者，仅供个人学习交流。

blocks.zh: 今天，我们推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，把前沿智能带给每一个人——为日常编程和智能体工作流提供速度与效率。
blocks.en: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.

blocks.zh: 我们的前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon 和 Gemini 4 Argon 擅长对最难的问题做深入、长程的推理，而 Hydrogen 则为在多样的智能体工作流中快速执行而打造。有了 Hydrogen，我们也将 Gemini 4 带给每一个人——覆盖谷歌 AI Studio 的所有档位、Gemini API、面向企业的 Gemini、Gemini 应用、谷歌搜索，以及付费的 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户在 Google Antigravity 中的使用。
blocks.en: While our frontier models, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, excel at deep, long-horizon reasoning on your hardest problems, Hydrogen is built for rapid execution across diverse agentic workflows. With Hydrogen, we’re also bringing Gemini 4 to everyone — for all tiers of Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, the Gemini app, Google Search, and paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity.

blocks.zh: 在默认的高思考档上，Hydrogen 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上超过 Argon（51 比 50，在最高的 xhigh 思考设置下可达 54），同时往往比同级别模型更快完成任务。Gemini 4 Hydrogen 在整个 100 万词元上下文窗口内统一定价：输入每百万词元 1.50 美元，输出每百万词元 7.50 美元。
blocks.en: Hydrogen surpasses Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high thinking level (51 vs. 50, and reaching 54 at its highest xhigh thinking setting), while often completing tasks faster than models in its class. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced flat across its entire 1 million-token context window at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.

blocks.zh: 释放多模型工作流中的效率
blocks.en: Unlocking efficiencies in multi-model workloads

blocks.zh: 在现实的软件开发中，团队在设计系统或排查隐蔽缺陷时会依赖 Carbon 和 Argon 这样的前沿模型来做深入的架构判断，但仍需要一个快速、有纪律的执行模型来写代码、跑测试并核实改动。Hydrogen 既可以独立胜任日常工作，也可以在多模型工作流中与 Carbon 和 Argon 搭配，充当高效率的执行引擎。
blocks.en: In real-world software development, while teams rely on frontier models like Carbon and Argon for deep architectural judgment when designing systems or untangling subtle bugs, they still need a fast, disciplined execution model for writing code, running tests, and verifying changes. Hydrogen is built to stand on its own as a model for everyday work — or to pair with Carbon and Argon as the high-efficiency execution engine in multi-model workflows.

blocks.zh: 为了让这种多模型协作自动进行，我们在 Google Antigravity 中推出 Orchestrator。它不再从头到尾只用一个模型，而是在同一次会话里动态切换 Carbon 和 Hydrogen 等模型。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上，Orchestrator 的任务成功率接近 Carbon，同时平均少消耗 24% 的配额，完成速度快 19%。对于需要并行智能体的工作流，Carbon 可以充当协调者，Hydrogen 则为工作者和校验者智能体提供动力，在相互隔离的工作区里同时构建和测试改动——帮助团队更快交付复杂项目，又不会推高词元成本。
blocks.en: To help make this multi-model collaboration automatic, we’re introducing Orchestrator in Google Antigravity. Rather than using a single model from start to finish, Orchestrator dynamically switches between models like Carbon and Hydrogen within the same session. On Terminal-Bench 4.0, Orchestrator reached near-Carbon task success rates while, on average, consuming 24% less quota and completing 19% faster. For workflows that require parallel agents, Carbon can act as the coordinator while Hydrogen can power worker and verifier agents to build and test changes simultaneously across isolated workspaces — helping teams ship complex projects faster without driving up token costs.

blocks.zh: 扩展开发者与企业工作流
blocks.en: Scaling developer and enterprise workflows

blocks.caption_zh: 比较 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 与其他模型的基准图表

blocks.zh: 除了多模型工作流，对从 Gemini 3.8 Flash 迁移的团队来说，Hydrogen 也是一次重大的独立升级。它在速度和智能上都有显著跃升——在默认的高档下完成任务速度快 2.5 倍，同时把 Terminal-Bench 4.1 得分提高两倍以上（57% 比 18.2%），把捏造的说法减少 5 倍以上，并在工具调用失败或搜索返回空结果时干净地适应。它还在核心的开发者和企业工作流中达到或超过同级别竞品：
blocks.en: Beyond multi-model workflows, Hydrogen is a major standalone upgrade for teams migrating from Gemini 3.8 Flash. It delivers significant leaps in both speed and intelligence — finishing tasks 2.5 times faster at its high default setting while more than tripling Terminal-Bench 4.1 scores (57% vs. 18.2%), cutting fabricated claims by more than 5x, and adapting cleanly when a tool call fails or a search returns empty. It also matches or outperforms competing models in its class across core developer and enterprise workflows:

blocks.zh: • 迭代式代码库编程与调试：Hydrogen 能处理问题修复、调试、快速迭代和代码库问答，并做有针对性的精准编辑——交付更干净、可投入生产的代码，而不会重写无关文件。在必须发现并修复缺陷且不能破坏现有代码的 SWE-sweep 上，它优于同档模型。为了高效探索大型代码库，该模型擅长原生地并行批量处理文件读取和搜索调用，而不是逐个检查文件；在复杂图表、SQL 和数据密集的企业工作流的早期测试中，合作伙伴看到 Hydrogen 比 3.8 Flash 快 2 倍到 2.8 倍，同时词元用量减少 12% 到 23%。
blocks.en: • Iterative repository coding and debugging: Hydrogen handles issue resolution, debugging, rapid iteration, and codebase Q&A with focused, surgical edits — delivering cleaner, production-ready code without rewriting unrelated files. It outperforms similar-tier models on SWE-sweep where it has to discover and repair bugs without breaking existing code. To explore large repositories efficiently, the model excels at natively batching file-read and search calls in parallel rather than inspecting files one by one; in early testing across complex graphs, SQL, and data-heavy enterprise workflows, our partners have seen Hydrogen run 2x to 2.8x faster while reducing token usage by 12% to 23%, compared to 3.8 Flash.

blocks.zh: • 开放式的智能体执行：在深度研究、数据分析和广泛的代码库导航等多步任务上，Hydrogen 在 arena.ai 的实时基准 Agent Arena 上排名第 5。在深度领域推理与分析方面，它在 HLE-Diamond 上以 58.8% 领先同级别，在 Vals Tax Agent Bench 上以 52.3% 总体排名第 1，在 Vals Legal Research Bench 上以 55.8% 并列第 1，并在 AutomationBench-AA 上领先同级别。
blocks.en: • Open-ended agentic execution: On multi-step tasks like deep research, data analysis, and broad codebase navigation, Hydrogen ranks #5 on Agent Arena, arena.ai’s live benchmark. For deep domain reasoning and analysis, it leads its class on HLE-Diamond (58.8%), ranks #1 overall on Vals Tax Agent Bench (52.3%), ties for #1 on the Vals Legal Research Bench (55.8%), and leads its class on AutomationBench-AA.

blocks.zh: • 多模态知识工作：Hydrogen 把原生的 100 万词元输入与最多 100 万输出词元结合起来，把密集的 PDF、电子表格、图表、音频和录制视频综合成完整、带引用的报告和结构化交付物。它在面向复杂视觉文件的端到端智能体知识工作的新基准 Multimodal Knowledge Agent（MKA）上以 53.4% 优于其他模型，并在面向端到端专业工作流的 Agents’ Last Exam v1.1 上达到 71.6%。
blocks.en: • Multimodal knowledge work: Hydrogen pairs native 1 million-token input with up to 1 million output tokens to synthesize dense PDFs, spreadsheets, charts, audio, and recorded video into polished, cited reports and structured deliverables. It outperforms other models on the new Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark (53.4%) for end-to-end agentic knowledge work over complex visual files, and on Agents’ Last Exam v1.1 (71.6%) for end-to-end professional workflows.

blocks.zh: • 网页开发：在对开发者来说速度很重要的任务上，例如实时界面原型、从设计到代码的迭代，以及交互式应用构建，Hydrogen 能用更少的提示生成更可用、功能更完整的布局。
blocks.en: • Web development: On tasks where speed matters to developers, like live UI prototyping, design-to-code iteration, and interactive app building, Hydrogen generates more functional, feature-complete layouts in fewer prompts.

blocks.zh: 四个思考档位上可调节的速度与智能
blocks.en: Adaptable speed and intelligence across four thinking levels

blocks.caption_zh: 展示 Artificial analysis intelligence index 的图表

blocks.zh: 我们打造 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，是为了真实世界中的可用性。Hydrogen 的四个思考档位——低、中、高（默认），以及全新的 xhigh 档——在质量、延迟和成本上提供了很宽的选择，并以平滑、可预期的方式递进，让你只为任务所需的推理深度等待和付费。在各个思考档上，Hydrogen 达到或超过部分同级别竞品，同时往往更快完成任务，并使用更少的输出词元。
blocks.en: We built Gemini 4 Hydrogen for real-world usability. Hydrogen’s four thinking levels — low, medium, high (default), and a new xhigh tier — offer a wide range of options across quality, latency, and cost, scaling in a smooth, predictable progression so you only wait and pay for the reasoning depth a task requires. Across thinking levels, Hydrogen matches or outperforms some of the competing models in its class while often finishing tasks faster and using fewer output tokens.

blocks.zh: 在 Gemini 应用和搜索中提供快速的日常帮助
blocks.en: Fast, everyday help in the Gemini app and Search

blocks.zh: 对消费者来说，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 让把事情做完变得更容易，能在多轮对话中更好地保持方向，也更严格地遵循指令。
blocks.en: For consumers, Gemini 4 Hydrogen makes it easier to get things done, staying on track and following instructions more closely across multi-turn conversations.

blocks.zh: 在 Gemini 应用中，Hydrogen 让你的日常助手更有帮助——它更善于遵循你的指导、调用合适的工具，并以更少的来回给你可靠的结果。
blocks.en: In the Gemini app, Hydrogen makes your everyday assistant even more helpful — it’s better at following your guidance, calling the right tools, and getting you to a reliable output with less back-and-forth.

blocks.zh: • 即拿即用的写作、研究和日常工作：Hydrogen 会紧贴你的语气、格式和具体规则，因此邮件草稿、学习指南、改写和文档往往第一次就能直接使用。当你在比较产品或综合密集材料时，它会整理出清晰的表格和可视化拆解，而不会漏掉关键细节。
blocks.en: • Ready-to-go writing, research, and everyday work: Hydrogen sticks closely to your tone, format, and specific rules, so email drafts, study guides, rewrites, and documents come back ready to use on the first try. When you are comparing products or synthesizing dense material, it pulls together clear tables and visual breakdowns without dropping key details.

blocks.zh: • 把线索连起来，完成更多任务：Hydrogen 会把你的目标逐步拆解，并从你上传的内容、Gmail 和 Google Drive 等谷歌应用，以及 Airtable 和 Dropbox 等已连接应用中提取相关上下文。当你在 Gemini 中开始一项任务时，它也更频繁地调用适合这项工作的工具和技能，帮助你在勾选待办时节省时间。
blocks.en: • Connects the dots and gets more tasks done: Hydrogen breaks down your goal step-by-step, pulling relevant context from your uploads, Google apps like Gmail and Google Drive, and Connected Apps like Airtable and Dropbox. When you start a task in Gemini, it also more frequently calls the right tools and skills for the job, helping save you time as you check things off your to-do list.

blocks.zh: • 日常原型与迭代：在探索和测试想法时，Hydrogen 能用更少的提示生成干净、可运行的布局，让你快速制作和打磨交互项目，例如把实时的全球闪电数据综合成一个交互式 3D 地球。
blocks.en: • Everyday prototyping and iteration: For exploring and testing ideas, Hydrogen generates clean, working layouts in fewer prompts, making it easy to prototype and refine interactive projects quickly, like synthesizing real-time global lightning strike data into an interactive 3D globe.

blocks.zh: Hydrogen 正在显著升级搜索，为全球所有用户提供更有帮助、更直观的回复。
blocks.en: Hydrogen is significantly upgrading Search, delivering more helpful, intuitive responses for all users globally.

blocks.zh: • 更好地理解你的真实意图：有了 Hydrogen，你可以用自己自然的思路提问——即便查询有多个部分、难以辨认的错字，或非常具体的要求——搜索也会智能地理解你在找什么。
blocks.en: • Better understands your true intent: With Hydrogen, you can ask your question in your natural flow of thought — even if you have multiple parts to your query, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests — and Search will intelligently comprehend what you’re looking for.

blocks.zh: • 更可视化的回复：你会得到高度适配、可视化且便于扫读的回复，它们会独特地贴合你的需求，并保持你对搜索所期待的速度。
blocks.en: • More visual responses: You’ll get highly adaptive, visual, and easy-to-scan responses that are uniquely relevant to your needs, at the speed you expect from Search.

blocks.zh: • 更广范围的相关链接：凭借 Hydrogen 的高级推理，我们也在升级搜索中的查询扇出技术，把你连接到比以往更广范围的有用链接，帮助你发现以前可能找不到的网站。
blocks.en: • Wider range of relevant links: With Hydrogen’s advanced reasoning, we’re also upgrading our query fan-out technique in Search, connecting you to a broader range of helpful links than before, helping you find sites you previously might not have discovered.

blocks.zh: 为大规模安全、可靠的执行而设计
blocks.en: Designed for safe, dependable execution at scale

blocks.zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 把我们最新的 Gemini 4 安全与安保技术栈中的改进，带给迄今最广泛的受众，把内置训练与实时界面防护结合起来，以帮助缓不同步和滥用。在基础防护之外，我们把重点放在对一款面向日常工作的更快模型来说最重要的两个领域：
blocks.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen brings improvements from our latest Gemini 4 safety and security stack to our broadest audience yet, combining built-in training with real-time surface safeguards to help mitigate both misalignment and misuse. Beyond foundational protections, we focused on two areas that matter most for a faster model that’s for everyday work:

blocks.zh: • 安全、对齐且有保障的智能体工作流：尽管 3.8 Flash 已有很强的对齐和防护，Hydrogen 仍是一次跃升。它把智能体任务中的过度越权最多减少 81%，把服务不足最多减少 79%，并在工具使用和编程评估中把未对齐的动作和任务走捷径减少 12 倍。在面对不可能或被阻断的任务时，它绕过权限边界的可能性最多降低 2 倍，并在我们内部的智能体诚实评估中达到 96.7% 的诚实率。延续我们对推理透明度的承诺，Hydrogen 还在超过 200,000 个受审计轮次中保持 99.9% 的思维链可读性，且没有任何欺骗性的推理编辑。面对间接提示注入攻击，Hydrogen 在 Gray Swan IPI 基准上的韧性提高 2.3 倍以上，同时在工具使用、计算机使用和编程智能体上显著提升稳健性。
blocks.en: • Safe, aligned, and secure agentic workflows: While 3.8 Flash has strong alignment and safeguards, Hydrogen is a leap ahead. It reduces overreach in agentic tasks by up to 81% and under-service by up to 79%, and cuts misaligned actions and task shortcutting across tool-use and coding evaluations by 12x. When faced with impossible or blocked tasks, it is up to 2x less likely to bypass permission boundaries and achieves a 96.7% honesty rate on our internal agent honesty evaluation.Building on our commitment to reasoning transparency, Hydrogen also preserves 99.9% chain-of-thought legibility with zero deceptive reasoning edits across more than 200,000 audited turns. Against indirect prompt injection attacks, Hydrogen is more than 2.3x more resilient on the Gray Swan IPI benchmark, while significantly improving robustness across tool use, computer use, and coding agents.

blocks.zh: • 有帮助、可靠的日常互动：在我们的产品界面上，我们调整 Hydrogen，让日常对话更可靠、也更安全。我们更新后的防护措施在区分真实的生物安全风险与正当的医学或科学问题方面也精确得多——把 HealthBench Pro 上的错误拒绝控制在 0.4% 以下。
blocks.en: • Helpful, reliable everyday interactions: Across our product surfaces, we tuned Hydrogen to make everyday conversations more reliable and safe. Our updated safeguards are also much more precise at distinguishing between real biosecurity risks and legitimate medical or scientific questions — keeping false refusals on HealthBench Pro under 0.4%.

blocks.zh: 更多细节请见 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型卡。
blocks.en: For more details see the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model card.

blocks.zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen，今天起面向每一个人开放
blocks.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, available to everyone today

blocks.zh: 从今天起，Hydrogen 将在我们的开发者、企业和消费者界面上全球逐步上线：
blocks.en: Starting today, Hydrogen is rolling out globally across our developer, enterprise, and consumer surfaces:

blocks.zh: • 面向开发者：在 AI Studio 和 Android Studio 中通过 Gemini API 构建，在 AI Studio 中试用；如果你是付费的 Google AI Pro 或 Ultra 订阅用户，还可以在 Google Antigravity 中试用。
blocks.en: • For developers: Build with the Gemini API in AI Studio and Android Studio, try it in AI Studio and if you’re a paid Google AI Pro or Ultra subscriber, you can try it in Google Antigravity.

blocks.zh: • 面向企业：通过 API 或模型下拉菜单在面向企业的 Gemini 中部署，也可在 Google Antigravity 中使用，并在符合条件的企业订阅下用于 Google 表格中的 Gemini。
blocks.en: • For enterprises: Deploy it in Gemini for business via the API or model drop down, Google Antigravity, and in Gemini in Google Sheets for eligible business subscriptions.

blocks.zh: • 面向所有人：在 Gemini 应用的模型下拉菜单和面向所有用户的谷歌搜索中开始使用，并先向 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户开放 Google 表格中的 Gemini。
blocks.en: • For everyone: Start using it in the Gemini app model drop down and in Google Search for all users, and in Gemini in Google Sheets starting with Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.
